title: Schedule of Cabin Upgrade Eligibility and Co-payment — Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
A ticket may be upgraded into a higher cabin after ticketing under Economy Classic, Economy Flex, Premium Economy Select, Business Saver and Business Flex. It may not be upgraded after ticketing under Basic Economy Lite or Economy Saver. Where an upgrade is accepted, a co-payment is collected for each traveller for each segment at the rate stated for the fare brand held. Both lines of Air Ticket Fare Brands are priced below.

| Fare brand | Upgrade into a higher cabin after ticketing | Co-payment for each traveller for each segment, USD |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | not eligible | 0.00 |
| Economy Saver | not eligible | 0.00 |
| Economy Classic | eligible | 350.00 |
| Economy Flex | eligible | 300.00 |
| Premium Economy Select | eligible | 250.00 |
| Business Saver | eligible | 150.00 |
| Business Flex | eligible | 100.00 |

Annotations. The co-payment is priced for each traveller and for each segment, so an accepted upgrade for two travellers over two segments held under Premium Economy Select is priced at the stated 250.00 four times over (a hypothetical illustration). The rate falls as the brand rises, from 350.00 under Economy Classic to 100.00 under Business Flex, the middle rungs being the 300.00 of Economy Flex and the 150.00 of Business Saver. The two brands that are not eligible for an upgrade after ticketing carry a co-payment line of 0.00.
